notes_for_editor: Unresolved: distance from the Continental Divide, a quarter mile on firelookout.com (1928 log cabin) vs three-quarters of a mile in the 1940 survey description quoted on Forest Lookouts; story says so. Survey text is read only as transcribed on Forest Lookouts; the NGS datasheet (PID ST0547) was not read directly. Elevation 8,090 ft is from firelookout.com only. Forest Lookouts header gives 25N-10W-8, but its Teton County index also lists 26N-10W-26 for a Wrong Ridge entry; not resolved. Independent Record (15 Dec 1933) mentions a 'Wrong Creek lookout peak' telephone line; possibly this lookout, not used. A 1940 Gus Kake 'fire prevention' station at Wrong Ridge is unclear as to lookout staffing; omitted. The brief's coordinates (47.93622, -112.9197) match the FFLA list; the west_us_lookouts value (47.95278, -112.91889) was not checked. Brief access 'unknown' kept: no source on public access. No photos found.
